## Où j'en suis
The Fernhill SAML ACS endpoint is finished: signature verification now runs on `signxml` (python3-saml was dropped), with hand-written checks for conditions, audience and subject confirmation (120 s skew), Redis replay protection, and attributes read only from the verified `signed_xml`. `saml_utils` moved to `api/auth/saml/verify.py`, ruff/mypy are clean and the test suite is green; PR #412 is merged into `main`.

- [en-cours] Loading Fernhill's staging IdP metadata is still to do (listed as remaining on the agent's task list)
- [prochaine-étape] Send Fernhill IT our staging SP metadata by Wednesday EOD, then the demo Thursday 10:00 New York; open the separate ticket for enforcing SSO / disabling password login
- [essai-raté] python3-saml on the Alpine image: lxml wheel and system libxml2 versions clash in xmlsec, and building lxml from source also failed (no loadable xmlsec crypto module), so it was abandoned
- [décision] Switch to signxml, remove python3-saml and xmlsec from the Dockerfile, write the condition checks with tests and only read from `signed_xml` (source: t08)
- [décision] Use a 120 s clock skew (contract annex), and leave password login out of this PR (source: t12)
- [décision] Merge neither with `--admin` nor `--auto`; the person pings Maya for review directly (source: t21)
